brief:
Israeli security and political assessments indicate a heightened likelihood of direct military confrontation with Iran in the coming weeks, the Maan wire reported, citing Hebrew-language Channel 14. The escalation could occur before upcoming elections in Israel.

The Israeli security establishment has raised its readiness to the highest level in preparation for potential conflict, despite recent statements from Donald Trump, according to the report.

title: Israeli security officials assess direct military confrontation with Iran likely within weeks
